column1: Indicator: Local Currency Sovereign Debt Securities Outstanding Maturity Profile

Definition: This indicator classifies outstanding sovereign debt securities by remaining time to maturity. Sovereign debt securities include Treasury instruments with remaining tenors longer than 1 year. The maturity profile is presented as a share of total outstanding sovereign debt securities in maturity buckets of >1–3
